1.0) * vec2(aspect, 1.0), u_fovZ));\n    vec3 eyepos = vec3(0.0, -0.0, -10.0);\n\n    const float far = 15.0;\n\n    RotateCamera(eyevec, eyepos);\n\n    vec3 color = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n\n    float dither = rand(uv) * 3.0;\n\n    float alpha = 0.;\n    vec3 raypos = eyepos + eyevec * dither * far / float(ITERATIONS);\n    vec3 pre_pos = raypos;\n    for (int i = 0; i < ITERATIONS; i++)\n    {        \n        WarpSpace(eyevec, raypos);\n        raypos += eyevec * far / float(ITERATIONS);\n        GasDisc(color, alpha, raypos, pre_pos);\n        Haze(color, raypos, alpha);\n        pre_pos = raypos;\n    }\n\n    color *= 0.03;\n    color = pow(color, vec3(1.5));\n    color = color / (1.0 + color);\n    color = pow(color, vec3(1.0 / 1.5));\n\n    color = mix(color, color * color * (3.0 - 2.0 * color), vec3(1.0));\n    color = pow(color, vec3(1.3, 1.20, 1.0));    \n\n    color = saturate(color * 1.01);\n\n    color = pow(color, vec3(0.7 / 2.2));\n\n    color *= u_brightness;\n\n    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);\n}\n\nvoid main() {\n  vec4 fragColor;\n  mainImage(fragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);\n  gl_FragColor = fragColor;\n}\n"

      value         : "varying vec2 v_ndc;\nuniform mat4 u_invVP;\nuniform vec3 u_camPos;\nuniform vec3 u_sunDir;\nuniform float u_Rg;\nuniform float u_Rt;\nuniform float u_sunIntensity;\nuniform float u_exposure;\n\n// 瑞利散射系数（每「行星半径」长度的消光），R 通道最弱、B 通道最强\nconst vec3 BETA = vec3(5.9, 13.9, 34.1);\n// 标高（行星半径单位）。真实地球约 0.0013，这里略厚一点让梯度更柔和\nconst float SCALE_H = 0.018;\n\n// 射线与球求交；相机在球外，返回最近与最远交点\nbool hitSphere(vec3 o, vec3 d, float r, out float t0, out float t1) {\n  float b = dot(o, d);\n  float c = dot(o, o) - r * r;\n  float disc = b * b - c;\n  if (disc < 0.0) return false;\n  float s = sqrt(disc);\n  t0 = -b - s;\n  t1 = -b + s;\n  return true;\n}\n\n// 从 p 沿太阳方向到大气顶的光学厚度（8 步）\nfloat sunOpticalDepth(vec3 p) {\n  float t0, t1;\n  if (!hitSphere(p, u_sunDir, u_Rt, t0, t1)) return 1e9;\n  float te = max(t1, 0.0001);\n  float sum = 0.0;\n  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n    float f = (float(i) + 0.5) / 8.0;\n    vec3 q = p + u_sunDir * (te * f);\n    float h = max(length(q) - u_Rg, 0.0);\n    sum += exp(-h / SCALE_H) * (te / 8.0);\n  }\n  return sum;\n}\n\nvoid main() {\n  vec4 pn = u_invVP * vec4(v_ndc, -1.0, 1.0); pn /= pn.w;\n  vec4 pf = u_invVP * vec4(v_ndc,  1.0, 1.0); pf /= pf.w;\n  vec3 rd = normalize(pf.xyz - pn.xyz);\n  vec3 ro = u_camPos;\n\n  float ta0, ta1;\n  if (!hitSphere(ro, rd, u_Rt, ta0, ta1)) { gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0); return; }\n  float tStart = max(ta0, 0.0);\n  float tEnd = ta1;\n\n  // 如果视线打到行星，就只积到地表\n  float tp0, tp1;\n  bool hitPlanet = hitSphere(ro, rd, u_Rg, tp0, tp1) && tp0 > 0.0;\n  if (hitPlanet) tEnd = min(tEnd, tp0);\n  if (tEnd <= tStart) { gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0); return; }\n\n  float mu = dot(rd, u_sunDir);\n  float phase = 0.0596831 * (1.0 + mu * mu);  // 3/(16π)\n\n  vec3 sumR = vec3(0.0);\n  float odView = 0.0;\n  const int STEPS = 24;\n  for (int i = 0; i < STEPS; i++) {\n    float u0 = float(i) / float(STEPS);\n    float u1 = float(i + 1) / float(STEPS);\n    float s0 = sqrt(u0);\n    float s1 = sqrt(u1);\n    float tA = tStart + (tEnd - tStart) * s0;\n    float tB = tStart + (tEnd - tStart) * s1;\n    float dt = tB - tA;\n    vec3 p = ro + rd * (tA + dt * 0.5);\n    float h = max(length(p) - u_Rg, 0.0);\n    float dens = exp(-h / SCALE_H);\n    odView += dens * dt;\n    float odSun = sunOpticalDepth(p);\n    vec3 trans = exp(-BETA * (odView + odSun));\n    sumR += dens * dt * trans;\n  }\n\n  vec3 scatter = sumR * BETA * phase * u_sunIntensity * 0.95;\n  scatter = vec3(1.0) - exp(-scatter * u_exposure);\n  // 昼夜项：用「所贴住的那个地表点」是否朝向太阳来压暗夜侧光晕，\n  // 否则只有 odSun 的软阴影，夜侧边缘仍会发亮\n  vec3 ringPoint = ro + rd * (hitPlanet ? tp0 : mix(tStart, tEnd, 0.5));\n  float facing = dot(normalize(ringPoint), u_sunDir);\n  float dayl = smoothstep(-0.18, 0.30, facing);\n\n  // 碰撞参数 b = |ro_dir × rd|：盘面中心 ≈ 0，地平线 ≈ 1，球外气体 > 1\n  // 碰撞参数 = 相机指向球心的矢量与视线方向的叉积模长（ro 不能归一化，\n  // 否则会被相机距离除一次，b 永远到不了 1，环带判定就失效了）\n  float b = length(cross(ro, rd));\n  // 空气质量：视线穿过的大气厚度。天顶（盘面中心）≈1，地平线附近急剧变厚\n  float mu0 = sqrt(max(1.0 - b * b, 0.0));\n  float airmass = 1.0 / max(mu0, 0.12);\n  // 瑞利内散射的色调：短波段散射得更多，叠加后整体发蓝、发白\n  const vec3 SKY_TINT = vec3(0.34, 0.58, 1.00);\n  float alpha;\n  vec3 col;\n  float strength = clamp(u_sunIntensity / 24.0, 0.0, 2.0);\n  if (hitPlanet) {\n    // 垂直光学厚度 = BETA * SCALE_H，斜视按 airmass 放大\n    vec3 tau = BETA * SCALE_H * airmass;\n    alpha = clamp(1.0 - exp(-tau.g), 0.0, 1.0) * strength;\n    col = min(SKY_TINT * alpha * u_sunIntensity * 0.045, vec3(0.85, 0.92, 1.0));\n  } else {\n    // 球外那圈气体：用积分出来的真实散射亮度\n    alpha = clamp(1.0 - exp(-BETA.g * odView * 1.5), 0.0, 1.0) * strength;\n    col = scatter * alpha;\n  }\n  col *= mix(0.05, 1.0, dayl);\n  gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha);\n}\n"
